parsed.doc_summary: NJ FAIR Act (P.L.2026, c.43, approved July 20, 2026) bars landlords from using, and coordinators from operating, algorithmic rent-pricing software that performs a coordinating function. It takes effect 2027-07-01 and bars conflicting municipal ordinances.

rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Landlords may not pay for or use a coordinator's algorithmic pricing software or device that performs a coordinating function, and no one may perform a coordinating function or engage in parallel pricing coordination for residential rents. Violations are violations of the NJ Antitrust Act.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic rent-setting coordination using competitively sensitive (nonpublic) data
rules.quoted_span: a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator;
rules.effective_date_note: Computed: act takes effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following enactment (approved 2026-07-20).
rules.penalty: Violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act (P.L.1970, c.73, sections 6-17 remedies preserved); Attorney General complaint portal.
rules.exemptions: Excludes research/statistical use not used to set prices, free public rent estimates, equal-terms brokerage listing databases, government affordability controls; excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, detention facilities; spreadsheets without AI and plain query databases are not algorithmic devices.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental residential dwelling units in NJ.
rules.interaction: Section 6(b) prohibits municipal ordinances that conflict with the act, so it may preempt local ordinances such as Jersey City and Hoboken.
rules.conflict_note: May preempt conflicting municipal algorithmic rent-pricing ordinances (e.g., Jersey City, Hoboken) once effective.

unverifiable_exemptions: inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, detention or correctional facilities
